cues.text: Hello Charlotte, I'm Caden, one of the supervisors.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Welcome to the team.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Hi Aidan.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: It's Caden.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I'm so sorry.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Don't worry, people often get my name wrong.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: They never know how to spell it.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: It's K-A-E-D-E-N, in case you ever need to write it.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I'll try and remember.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: So, there are a few practical things you need to sort out this morning.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Then I'll show you what you're going to do today.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: The email I received said to go to the front desk to show my letter of appointment and pick up my badge.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: You'll need that for the staff room and other areas of the supermarket where shoppers aren't allowed.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: So, after you've finished at the front desk, I'll take you to the staff room.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Put your coat and rucksack in one of the lockers there.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Take whichever one is free.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Will I have a key?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Try not to lose it.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: At the end of the day, leave it in the door for the next person to use.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Will do.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: You also need to go to the HR department to see Tiffany.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: She's really helpful.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I was told to bring my passport with me.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: HR need to take a note of the number in it.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: That's right.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Or you can show your ID card.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I don't have one of those.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Tiffany will give you a uniform.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: They have lots in different sizes, so you just tell her what you need.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I won't come with you to HR.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I've got to go and sort something else out.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Um, problem with a bread slicer.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Is the HR office near the staff room?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: The staff room's on the first floor and HR are a couple of floors above that, on the third floor.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: There's a staircase outside the staff room.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: When you've finished with HR, come and find me in the bakery section of the shop.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I'm looking forward to getting started.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: I'll just give you my phone number in case you can't find me.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Have you got your phone there?
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Ready.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Done.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: So, Charlotte, your tasks today are in the bakery section, on the sushi counter and on the meat and fish counters.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: If any of the dates are today's, put a new price label on the packaging.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: What if any of the labels are yesterday's dates or older?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Do I throw those items away?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Yes, but that shouldn't happen.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: We check the stock every day.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: When something needs a new price label, put a yellow one on the package, next to the original price.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: After that, you'll go to the sushi takeaway counter.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Will I be preparing boxes of food?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: For today, you'll just be helping the staff.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Yes, of course.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: You'll see lots of flat cardboard boxes at one end of the counter.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Beneath those is where we keep the plastic boxes.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: We run out of those really quickly, so you should bring more from the storeroom.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Is that my only task on the sushi counter?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: No.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: You also need to clean the area where they prepare the dishes.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: There are cloths and bottles of spray by the sink.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Oh, and please make sure you clean that, too.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Sure.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: That's important, isn't it?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Absolutely.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: But you mustn't wash up knives.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: You have to do some training before you're allowed to touch sharp objects.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: What should I do if there are any?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Ask someone to put them in the dishwasher.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: OK, thanks.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: I don't want to get anything wrong.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: And I'll be around to help.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Finally, the meat and fish counters.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: You need to clean the area where staff serve customers, including wiping the weighing scales.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Anything else?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: The fish is laid on ice, but when that starts to melt, you'll need to get more from the cold room.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: I know the staff on the food counters wear a hat.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: Will that be the same for me?
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE

cues.text: You won't be serving customers directly, so no.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: But make sure you put on thermal gloves when you take anything out of the cold room.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: The temperature's low enough in there to get frostbite from touching things.
cues.speaker: KAEDEN

cues.text: Understood.
cues.speaker: CHARLOTTE
